text:
Maya: quick async from me — mid-day handoff for apac prewarm / quotas. saw spot evictions spike, prewarm pool ap-southeast-1 dropped 18 -> 12 and a couple canaries had +120ms tail latency. filed ticket #4387. what I did: bumped prewarm with `rbctl scale --pool prewarm-apac --replicas 24`, validated canary trace, checked node health.

Sam: ack. will review PR 7822 (autoscaler backoff tweak) in ~1h. can you paste the exact latency traces?

Maya: pasted short trace below (trimmed):
```
2026-03-18T10:02Z canary-1 latency_p50=18ms p95=85ms p99=220ms
2026-03-18T10:07Z canary-2 latency_p50=20ms p95=105ms p99=260ms
```

Devon: saw a single node drain that coincided with the evictions. log snippet: `kubelet: pod "worker-7" OOMKilled, reason=Evicted(tensor_cache)`. suspect old cache not clearing fast enough. suggestion: reduce node drain grace to 90s for prewarm lane so we recycle faster. also adding a small cron to clear `/var/tmp/tensor_cache` after drains.

Indra: flipped cloud support a note earlier — ticket 2026-03-18-APAC-Quota opened. cloud asked for 24h usage spike chart, I attached link to aggregated metrics: https://internal/metrics/gpu/apac/24h (internal). asked them for an emergency bump to +8 G4s in ap-southeast-1.

Sam: re: PR 7822 — If we lower the backoff cap from 120s -> 60s it should reduce time-to-recover during transient spot spikes. left a couple inline comments.

Liam: quick heads-up: I'm on-call tonight 18:00-22:00 UTC. if quota comes through, ping me and I'll own the scale window.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout `rc2` started at 2026-03-18T10:15Z, threshold=5% — monitoring enabled. :eyes:

Maya: awesome, thanks. blockers: waiting on cloud quota approval and Sam's PR review. next steps today: 1) follow up on support ticket and attach peak CSV, 2) merge PR and run a small canary, 3) schedule scaling window with Liam if quota approved.

Sam: will prioritize the review.

Indra: I'll ping cloud again in ~30m.

Devon: I'll prototype the cache-clean cron and open a tiny PR referencing #4387.

Maya: perfect. tagging this handoff — if anything urgent after 16:00 UTC call @Liam. :thumbsup:
